title: Transfer news LIVE: Man Utd triple deal, Newcastle move off, Arsenal's Guimaraes agreement - The Mirror
text:
Hello, and welcome to the Mirror's transfer news blog on Sunday, July 12.

The window is now in full swing with teams preparing their squad for the new season, Premier League teams have started to return for pre-season as preparations for the 2026/27 campaign ramp up.

The training sessions give managers a chance to have a closer look at their squads and assess any incomings or outgoings. Several clubs have already been active in the transfer window.

Man United are a club looking for incomings, but are yet to make a signing. Midfield is a priority for Michael Carrick, with a lot of talk surrounding the deal for Ederson falling through.

There's now reports that they've made contact over a possible deal for Wolves' Joao Gomes, but they could face competition from Liverpool.

Reds boss Andoni Iraola is looking to be active in the window and have also been linked with PSG's Bradley Barcola, but Arsenal are also showing an interest.

There's bound to be a lot of twists and turns in the transfer window over the next few days and weeks and we'll bring you the latest right here on the blog below.

Atalanta insist that Ederson is 100% fit and will offer their player a new five-year contract next week, according to Fabrizio Romano.

However, it is said that the player will have to decide whether to sign that new deal or stay on the transfer market, having entered the final 12 months of his contract with the Serie A side. They had previously agreed a deal with Manchester United for the Brazil international, but that move appears to be off after the results of a medical.

(Image: AFP via Getty Images)

Aurelien Tchouameni, Ibrahima Konate and Kylian Mbappe are pressuring Michael Olise to tell Bayern Munich that he wants to join Real Madrid, according to El Debate.

It is said that he wants to meet with the Bundesliga champions over his future at the club, namely their president, who is Herbert Hainer, after the World Cup.

Michael Olise(Image: Ulrik Pedersen/ZUMA Press Wire/Shutterstock)

Aston Villa have enquired about signing Pervis Estupinan, according to Matteo Moretto.

The former Brighton & Hove Albion player is said to be available and could leave Milan this summer, with the club willing to listen to offers for him. Villa have reportedly asked how much it would cost for Estupinan after making contact about the feasibility of doing a deal for the Ecuador international.

However, they have yet to make any official offer to bring him back to the Premier League. Estupinan's time at Milan has not worked out for either party so far and could soon be over.

(Image: 2025 Vince Mignott/MB Media)

Manchester United have told Marseille that they will not exercise their option to re-sign Mason Greenwood, according to Fabrizio Romano.

Fenerbahce and Marseille are reportedly due to take the formal steps to reach an agreement so that the one-time England international can travel to Istanbul. United stand to earn over £10million from the sell-on clause they included in their deal with the French club when selling their academy graduate.

Marseille are said to be selling Greenwood for over £34million, with a four-year contract to follow. Fenerbahce director Oguz Cetin has already claimed that the forward is "coming" to the club.

(Image: Getty Images)

Aston Villa must first sort out their finances before they can sign Johan Manzambi, according to The Chronicle.

Newcastle United verbally agreed on wages with the Switzerland international after positive talks. Manzambi, however, did not sign after being asked, and there is now said to be radio silence at this stage, after taking time to consider his options.

The Magpies are understandably disappointed that their deal could be about to fall through. They have a £ 49 million transfer in place with his club, Freiburg, but Manzambi reportedly wants to sign for Villa now rather than join Newcastle this summer.

(Image: Jared C. Tilton - FIFA, FIFA via Getty Images)

Newcastle United have agreed to sign Arsenal academy player Kyran Thompson, according to Fabrizio Romano.

The England under-17 winger is said to have chosen them from five proposals and will leave the Premier League champions as a free agent. The Daily Mail previously reported that the 16-year-old was closing in on a move to Tottenham Hotspur. Arsenal spent £1.1million on signing the teenager from West Ham United two years ago.

Aston Villa are finalising the signing of Johan Manzambi, according to The Athletic.

Newcastle United had reportedly reached an agreement with Freiburg but did not reach one with the Switzerland international. Manzambi is now said to want a move to Villa after they intensified their interest in the 20-year-old midfielder.

Bayern Munich president Herbert Hainer believes Harry Kane wants to sign a new contract with Bundeliga club, who are equally keen on agreeing an extension, telling BILD:

Kane has guided to Three Lions to another major tournament semi final

Besiktas are confident of completing a deal for Leandro Trossard next week, according to Fabrizio Romano.

They have already agreed a £17million move with Arsenal and are offering the Belgium international a three-year contract. Trossard, however, has yet to give the transfer his go-ahead.

The forward is into the final 12 months of his current deal with the Premier League champions, who appear more inclined to cash in on the 31-year-old rather than keeping him around for another season. Arsenal signed Trossard for £27million from Brighton and Hove Albion three-and-a-half years ago and has made 174 appearances since then.

(Image: Stuart MacFarlane/Arsenal FC via Getty Images)

Wolverhampton Wanderers have rejected a loan offer from Fiorentina for Tolu Arokodare, according to Sky Sports.

Trabzonspor are also credited with an interest in the Nigeria international and have reportedly sent Wolves a bid. Arokodare is said to not be keen on a move to Turkey, wanting to stay in one of Europe's top-five leagues, which Fiorentina just about are after avoiding relegation from Serie A last season.

Their offer's loan fee, though, is said to have come nowhere near what Wolves want for their striker, who is under contract for at least under three seasons, and potentially a fourth.

(Image: CameraSport via Getty Images)

Barcelona want over £40million for Ferran Torres, according to SPORT. Paris Saint-Germain, however, are reportedly unwilling to meet that asking price.

Torres has less than a year left on his contract with the Catalan club and is said to have reached an agreement with PSG to join them this summer.

The former Manchester City player is currently representing Spain at this summer's World Cup, so nothing will happen until after their involvement ends this weekend, either in a final or third-place match. PSG are in the market for a new forward after selling Goncalo Ramos to Milan earlier in the transfer window.

Ferran Torres of FC Barcelona(Image: GSI/Icon Sport via Getty Images)

Borussia Dortmund have an agreement in principle with Kosta Karetsas, according to Sky Germany.

The 18-year-old and his family are said to be keen on the move, with personal terms reportedly not an issue. Talks are ongoing between Dortmund and Genk, Karetsas's club, after they turned down an offer worth over £22million, which is still some way short of their £30million valuation of the teenager.

Top clubs across Europe, including within the Premier League, have been credited with an interest in the Greece international this year. However, it appears that Karetsas wants to join Dortmund this summer to develop further.

Konstantinos Karetsas is a player who has been linked with Arsenal in the transfer window(Image: (Photo by Tomas Sisk / Photonews via Getty Images))

Galatasaray are signing Lesley Ugochukwu from Burnley, according to Fabrizio Romano.

The former Chelsea midfielder is said to be moving for £25million. Ugochukwu spent last season playing in the Premier League for Burnley after a spell on loan at Southampton while they were in the top flight,

Chelsea signed the France under-21 international for £23million three years ago, but decided to cash in for around £20million last summer. The midfielder will reportedly sign a contract with Galatasaray shortly after they agreed a package with the recently relegated Clarets, in what appears to be their first signing of the transfer window.

(Image: Darren Walsh/Getty Images)

Chelsea have made a second offer for Pep Chavarria, according to Simon Phillips.

The left-back is said to be a player who Xabi Alonso put forward to his club as a replacement for Marc Cucurella, who the Blues sold to Real Madrid within days of appointing their new manager. A first offer from the Blues was reportedly worth around £10million and it now appears they have raised that to £15million.

Rayo Valecano, however, seemingly want closer to £20million for the defender. Chavarria signed a five-year contract barely 12 months ago, so they appear to be in a strong negotiating position.

Chelsea are interested in Pep Chavarria(Image: GSI/Icon Sport via Getty Images)

Arsenal and Bruno Guimaraes have agreed on a five-year contract, according to L'Equipe.

Newcastle United's captain is said to have told the club's directors and head coach Eddie Howe about his wish to join the Premier League champions. The Gunners have reportedly made a £60million offer for the Brazil international, with his former club Lyon receiving a percentage of the profit, which explains the French sports newspaper's interest.

They suggest that if Guimaraes goes for £70million, they will earn around £5million four years after first selling him for £40million, because they are due 20% of the profit on any future sale.

HOUSTON, USA - JUNE 29: Bruno Guimaraes of Brazil reacts during the FIFA World Cup 2026 Round of 32 match between Brazil and Japan at Houston Stadium (NRG Stadium) on June 29, 2026 in Houston, Texas. (Photo by Hakan Akgun/Anadolu via Getty Images)(Image: Getty )

Manchester United will announce the signing of Cristian Orozco alongside the impending arrivals of Andrey Santos and Cristian Orozco.

The club are due to complete a transfer for Orozco, with a formal announcement to follow. They are also finalising deals for Darlow and Santos, who will both be unveiled before the end of this month.

Orozco turns 18 on Monday, which is the age at which United can register the Colombian, and will join up with the club's under-21s rather than the first team squad. The teenager is already in England after first visiting Manchester late last year for tennis.

Manchester United have agreed a deal for Colombia U17 international Cristian Orozco(Image: Noushad Thekkayil/NurPhoto via Getty Images)

Fulham have reportedly sent a request to take Real Madrid youngster on loan, a deal which will see him link back up with Alvaro Arbeloa.

Argentine outlet El Intransigente claim that Fulham have made formal contact with Real Madrid for a season-long loan deal.

The attacking midfielder is named as a 'top priority' for Arbeloa, who managed Real Madrid for the second half of last season, following Xabi Alonso's departure.

The Spanish boss was unveiled as the new Fulham manager last week.

Alvaro Arbeloa has left Real Madrid after five months(Image: Getty Images)

There is a disagreement in the valuation of Bruno Guimaraes between Arsenal and Newcastle United.

GiveMeSport reports that the Gunners are expected to open formal conversations with the Magpies over a potential deal soon.

However, Arsenal are said to be prepared to offer a price of £60-65 million, whereas Newcastle value the Brazilian at a price of £80-90 million .

If negotiations between the two clubs can close the gap is still be to seen.

Bruno Guimaraes is pushing for a move to Arsenal(Image: CameraSport via Getty Images)

Man City confirmed the signing of Jeremy Monga from Leicester City on Saturday, with the 17-year-old signing a long-term deal at the Etihad Stadium.

The agreement will see City pay Leicester a fee of £10 million, plus a further £2.5 million in add-ons.

Monga looked likely to be heading to Arsenal earlier in the summer before City made their move.

Following confirmation of the transfer, the winger took to social media to send an emotional goodbye message to Leicester. He then responded to his move to City.

He wrote: "A new chapter begins. Grateful for the journey so far - now it's time to get to work. Thank you for the support"

Arsenal are showing an interest in re-signing Dino Mavronpanos after the defender suffered relegation with West Ham last season.

The Greek international joined Arsenal in January 2018, but spent most of his time at the club out on loan in search of regular game time. He joined German side Stuttgart permanently in 2023, but returned to the Premier League with West Ham a year later.

Sky Sports reports that Arsenal are one of the sides showing an interest in the player, who is expected to leave the London Stadium this summer.

READ MORE HERE

Former Manchester United boss Ruben Amorim is reportedly eyeing a reunion with one of his former players.

Journalist Matteo Moretto claims that United full-back Noussair Mazraoui is one of the manager's targets at AC Milan this summer, but talks between the two clubs are yet to take place.

Amorim left United last season, and returned to management this summer, taking over at the Italian club.

Ruben Amorim left Manchester United in January(Image: Getty Images)

The father of Newcastle United midfielder Bruno Guimaraes has taken to social media following reports that he's told the club that he wants to join Arsenal.

The Gunners are keen to sign the Brazilian this summer, and look poised to make an offer to Newcastle.

The message comes amid the speculation and in the aftermath of Brazil's exit from the World Cup.

Translated from Portuguese, Dick Guimaraes said:

Manchester United retain an interest in Brighton midfielder Carlos Baleba, but it is not a deal that the club are working on at this moment in time, reports the Manchester Evening News.

United are continuing their desperate search for midfield reinforcements over the summer transfer window, with speculation that a deal for Ederson has now fallen through.

Carlos Baleba is a name who has been mentioned for the last 12 or so months, after United made contact with Brighton/

However, they were initially put off by the Seagull's valuation of the player.

Carlos Baleba of Brighton looks on during the Premier League match between Brighton & Hove Albion and Manchester United at Amex Stadium(Image: Getty)

Leeds United have announced that Alex Cairns has signed a new two-year deal to extend his stay at Elland Road.

The goalkeeper made his debut for the club in the 2011/12 campaign, and after a spell away, returned in 2024.

Speaking to the club website, he said:

Manchester United are more open to reintegrating Marcus Rashford back into the first team squad this season, with positive talks held between the parties, according to the Manchester Evening News.

Rashford is currently away on World Cup duty with England, after their win to make it through to the semi-final on Saturday night. But he is due to return to Carrington upon his return from the tournament.

He spent last season on loan with Barcelona and made no secret of his desire to return to the Spanish club, but they decided against triggering a £26 million buy option.

It's added that a departure from United is still seen as the best option, but a stay is now not being ruled out by the club.

Marcus Rashford is currently in America with the England squad for the World Cup.(Image: Kyle Rivas, Getty Images)

Newcastle United may now have been given the green light to sign Johan Manzambi.

The club have reportedly agreed a £49 million fee with German side Freiburg for the midfielder, with personal terms also sorted.

However, the 20-year-old is said to have wanted to concentrate on the World Cup with Switzerland before making the move.

The Swiss fell to a 3-1 defeat against Argentina in the quarter-final in the early hours of Sunday morning. Manzambi missed the game with a knee injury.

The exit from the competition could mean that a transfer is completed sooner rather than later.

INGLEWOOD, CALIFORNIA - JUNE 18: Johan Manzambi #9 of Switzerland celebrates scoring his team's first goal during the FIFA World Cup 2026 Group B match between Switzerland and Bosnia and Herzegovina at Los Angeles Stadium on June 18, 2026 in Inglewood, California. (Photo by Alex Livesey - FIFA/FIFA via Getty Images)

Five English sides, including newly-promoted Coventry City and newly-relegated West Ham, are showing an interest in Bodo/Glimt and Norway star Patrick Berg, according to reports.

TEAMtalk claims that there is significant interest from Coventry, Hull and Ipswich Town in the midfielder. It's added that the player himself is ready to explore opportunities after spending almost his entire career with Bodo/Glimt.

The midfielder was part of Norway's squad, which made it to the World Cup quarter-final, with the side losing to England in extra time on Saturday night.

(Image: Getty Images)

Chelsea are reportedly in 'contact' with the representatives of Adam Wharton over a possible move for the midfielder this summer.

CaughtOffside reports that contact remains, but a breakthrough is unlikely in the short-term.

Wharton has been of interest to Tottenham, Man Utd and Liverpool, but all three are said to have been put off by Crystal Palace's valuation of the player. Spurs stepping away after signing Sandro Tonali and Mateus Fernandes for a combined £185 million

Palace are said to want a similar figure to the £116 million paid by Man City to Nottingham Forest for Elliot Anderson.

Adam Wharton of Crystal Palace celebrates with the trophy at the end of the UEFA Conference League Final 2026 match between Crystal Palace FC and Rayo Vallecano de Madrid at Football Arena Leipzig(Image: Getty)

Mohamed Salah could be on the move to America with MLS side Sporting Kansas City the 'top suitor' for the former Liverpool man.

The Athletic reports that Salah remains open to a move to the MLS and is continuing to consider his options.

If he decides to move to the MLS, Sporting Kansas City sits ahead of the queue, with the club's new majority owner, Peter Mallouk, the son of Egyptian immigrants.

Mohamed Salah of Liverpool appears emotional as he applauds the fans following his final appearance for the club during the Premier League match between Liverpool and Brentford at Anfield(Image: Getty)

Liverpool's Curtis Jones has responded to reports that a deal has been agreed for him to move to Nottingham Forest this summer.

The midfielder could leave Anfield, with Juventus, Inter Milan and Galatasaray all linked with an interest.

However, it was claimed online that Forest had struck a deal for Jones. Taking to Instagram to respond, the England international commented with a raised eyebrow emoji, hinting that the news may not be true.

Curtis Jones could be on the move this summer(Image: Robbie Jay Barratt - AMA, Getty Images)
